title: HankelKANet: Lightweight Path Loss Estimation via Physics-Inspired Hankel Convolution
abstract: arXiv:2610.19524v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accurate path loss (PL) estimation is essential for wireless network planning and optimization. This paper proposes HankelKANet, a lightweight physics-inspired network for PL estimation that structurally embeds electromagnetic propagation characteristics into the neural architecture. Built on a single residual UNet backbone, the proposed model integrates urban layout features with a convolutional Kolmogorov-Arnold network(KAN). Specifically, the convolutional kernels are parameterized by the radial amplitudes of the zeroth- and first-order Hankel functions. This formulation acts as a physics-inspired nonlinear distance encoding, enabling the network to capture dominant attenuation characteristics directly without requiring additional physics-based loss terms. Experimental results demonstrate that HankelKANet achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and efficiency on both the simulated RadioMapSeer dataset and the real-world Huawei RSRPSet. Com

translated_title: HankelKANet：基于物理启发汉克尔卷积的轻量级路径损耗估计
translated_abstract: 准确的路径损耗（PL）估计对于无线网络的规划与优化至关重要。本文提出了HankelKANet，一种用于路径损耗估计的轻量级物理启发网络，它将电磁传播特性结构化地嵌入到神经架构中。该模型建立在单个残差UNet骨干网络之上，将城市布局特征与卷积Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）相结合。具体而言，卷积核由零阶和一阶汉克尔函数的径向幅度进行参数化。这种设计作为一种物理启发的非线性距离编码，使网络能够直接捕获主要的衰减特性，而无需额外的基于物理的损失项。实验结果表明，HankelKANet在模拟的RadioMapSeer数据集和真实世界的华为RSRPSet数据集上均实现了最先进的精度和效率。
tldr: HankelKANet通过用零阶和一阶汉克尔函数的径向幅度参数化卷积核，将电磁传播特性结构化嵌入轻量级残差UNet架构，无需额外物理损失项即可实现最先进精度和效率的路径损耗估计。
en_tdlr: HankelKANet structurally embeds electromagnetic propagation characteristics into a lightweight residual UNet by parameterizing convolutional kernels with the radial amplitudes of zeroth- and first-order Hankel functions, achieving state-of-the-art path loss estimation accuracy and efficiency without requiring additional physics-based loss terms.
